scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: npm run clear && concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run develop"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && npm run start" "cd frontend && npm run start"
